transcript: In my previous team at a payments company, our release builds took 30 minutes and everyone complained but nobody owned it. I helped cut our build time from 30 to 6 minutes by caching the dependencies and splitting the test suite so the slow parts run in parallel. I wrote most of the pytest suite we still run today, and I built the FastAPI service that handles our payments. I also helped the team move to small daily releases instead of the big monthly one.
followups: You said the build dropped from 30 to 6 minutes — what exactly did you change?
Was splitting the test suite your idea or the team's?
Can you remember a time a fast build saved a release?
